privacy_notice_short: By registering, you share your name and e-mail with the organizer. Registration data, attendance included, is deleted automatically after the retention period.
privacy_who: The university running this service controls the data. The event's organizers can see registration data.
privacy_what: We process your name, e-mail address, registrations for events and agenda items, and attendance to organize the event and send messages about it.
privacy_retention: Registration data, attendance and groups included, is deleted automatically {days} days after the event ends. Account data (name, e-mail) is kept until you delete your account.
privacy_rights: You may access, correct, delete and move your data: on your account page you can download it or delete your account. You may also complain to the Polish data protection authority (UODO).
account_data_body: You can download everything we keep about you, or delete your account with its registrations.
account_data_delete_body: We'll withdraw you from upcoming events (waitlisted people get the places), close your groups and delete the account. This can't be undone.
reg_email_reminder_intro: A reminder: {event} starts {date}. See you there!

error_sole_organizer: You're the only organizer of an upcoming event. Add a co-organizer or cancel the event before deleting your account.
error_last_admin: This is the last admin account. Make someone else an admin before deleting it.
privacy_basis: The basis is your registration for the event, the service you ask for (GDPR art. 6(1)(b)).
error_reauth_required: For your security, sign in again, then delete your account.

a11y_intro: The university is committed to making this service accessible in line with the Polish Act of 4 April 2019 on the digital accessibility of public bodies' websites and mobile applications.
a11y_status: The service is partially compliant with WCAG 2.1 level AA. Every participant and organiser screen and the main dialogs are checked automatically: WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 AA rules (axe-core), page titles, reflow at 320 px, keyboard use and visible focus. A full expert audit has not taken place yet.
a11y_known: Known limitations: the ticket scanner needs a camera — attendance can also be marked by hand on the list; PDF files (tickets, certificates, attendance sheets) are not tagged yet.
a11y_prepared: This statement was prepared on 21 November 2026 by self-assessment.
a11y_contact: Report accessibility problems to: {email}. We will reply within 7 days at the latest.
a11y_contact_generic: Report accessibility problems to the site administrator. We will reply within 7 days at the latest.
a11y_complaint: If we refuse to provide accessibility, you can file a complaint and then apply to the Commissioner for Human Rights.
